stories.title: AI cheating scandal rattles South Korea as annual college exam looms
summary: Fears for national entrance exam next week, as top scorer on tax exam admits sending photos of questions to AI toolThe marks attained by the top scorer ⁠on South Korea’s national exam for aspiring tax accountants this year seemed too good to be true.

On Sunday, sceptics were ⁠proven right when he ⁠confessed to ​using generative AI to cheat.The scandal follows months of speculation after he scored near-perfect marks on hundreds of questions over two exams ⁠taken in April and July.
It has also raised the stakes for organisers of South Korea’s annual college entrance exam this Thursday.

summary: Volatile weather predicted after storms on Saturday, with a man in his 20s struck by lightning while swimming on NSW Central CoastGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastDangerous and severe “supercell” thunderstorms with the potential for giant hail and destructive winds were forecast for parts of New South Wales on Sunday, as volatile weather continued in the eastern states over the weekend.Storms dumped heavy rain across large parts of northern and eastern NSW and much of Queensland on Saturday, with strong winds recorded up to 98km/h in Goulburn and rainfall totals of between 30mm and 50mm in the Coffs Harbour area.
